socket_path.description: Unix socket path where fcgiwrap will listen for FastCGI connections (e.g., /var/run/fcgiwrap.socket).

user.description: User account under which the fcgiwrap processes will run. Must have read/execute permissions to your CGI scripts and web content.

group.description: Group under which the fcgiwrap processes will run.

num_processes.description: Number of fcgiwrap worker processes to spawn. Increase if you expect high concurrency of CGI requests.

socket_mode.description: File permissions (octal) for the socket file. Controls access for the web server (e.g., nginx/Apache) to connect.
